brief:
Israel struck a civilian transport vehicle in Gaza City, killing five people, Middle East Eye reported. The strike occurred as ceasefire violations continued one year into a truce agreement between the two sides.

Palestinians said there is "no safe place" in Gaza following the attack. The incident marked the latest in a series of breaches of the ceasefire terms since the agreement took effect a year ago.

title: Israel kills eight in Gaza as ceasefire violations persist
